craft_notes: Sthāyin: withhold-joy. Rows: row 3 (neither/nor). Close: release. Rejected: 'gods' — kept intensified; 'instant' — 'swift' kept.

lines: Not yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly wins this prize —
the heart of gods' own God, where swift yoga-release lies.
l4.sanskrit_cite: etan nā yoginījāto nā rudro labhate sphuṭam | hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam

reads_against.argmap: Neither yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly gets this heart — at once yoga-release-giving.
c1_essence: Heart withheld from yoginī-born and Rudra; swift yoga-release.
